# Gujarat Bio Organics Pvt. Ltd.
> Farmer website of Gujarat Bio Organics Pvt. Ltd., Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India. Working with farmers since 2006. Makes biostimulants (main line), biofertilizers and organic fertilizers; sells the Immunity crop formulas. Business buyers: https://b2b.gujaratbio.com

- Factory: Plot No. 321, GIDC 2, Ghanghali Road, Shihor, Bhavnagar, Gujarat 364240
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99787 91167; email: sales@gujaratbio.com
- Approvals: NOCs from the Directorate of Agriculture, Government of Gujarat for 36 Schedule VI biostimulant grades and 11 biofertilizer types.

## Immunity products
- [Immunity Sugarcane Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-sugarcane-special): A crop formula for sugarcane, built for tired soil, poor germination and uneven growth.
- [Immunity Potato Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-potato-special): A crop formula for potato, for growers seeing fewer, smaller tubers and rising fertilizer bills.
- [Immunity Mango Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-mango-special): A crop formula for mango trees, for decline, alternate bearing, fruit drop and small fruit.
- [Immunity Apple Special](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-apple-special): A crop formula for apple orchards, for plant mortality, low production and poor fruit quality.
- [Immunity Gold](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-gold): Our general formula for all crops: field crops, vegetables, fruit and plantation crops.
- [Immunity Granules](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/products/immunity-granules): Soil-applied granules that release slowly, for soil structure and soil life.

## Crop guides
- [Sugarcane](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/sugarcane): Poor germination, gaps, uneven growth and worn-out soil.
- [Potato](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/potato): Fewer, smaller tubers and rising fertilizer bills.
- [Mango](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/mango): Tree decline, alternate bearing, fruit drop and small fruit.
- [Apple](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/apple): Plant mortality, root rot, low production and poor quality.
- [Banana](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/banana): Wilt, leaf spot, plant losses and low bunch weight.
- [Citrus](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/citrus): Dieback, fruit drop and weak roots.
- [Coconut](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/coconut): Low nut yield, button shedding and weak palms.
- [Cotton](https://agriculture.gujaratbio.com/crops/cotton): Weak early growth, square and boll shedding, tired soil.
